HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ART.title: Nail Art
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ART.description: Great Slash, Cyclone Slash and Dash Slash are the three charged Nail techniques. Playing one releases it immediately. Charged Arts, Pride's Mark and Nailmaster's Glory enhance Nail Arts.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL.title: SOUL
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL.description: Gathered by Nail strikes and by losing HP. Spells and Focus spend it. The vessel empties between battles.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM.title: Companion Summons
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM.description: One living companion of each species, up to 24 HP each. Repeated summons add current and maximum HP; at the cap they still heal. Companions intercept unblocked enemy attacks; overflow hits you. They do not inherit nail strength or naturally gain SOUL. Soul Nourishment enables capped Weaverling command SOUL gain. Maturity only boosts the end-of-turn flame.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_COMMAND.title: Companion Commands
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_COMMAND.description: Each directed strike counts once for command combos. Multi-hit commands count each strike; area commands count once. Automatic turn-end attacks do not count. The count resets at the start of your turn.
